{{Quote|You Humans&hellip; you all look ''alike'' to me. Is that remark ''insensitive?'' I don't mean to offend&mdash;especially not when you're ''trespassing'' through our sacred grounds. So tell me&hellip; what are you soldiers doing in our forest?|[[Toma patrol leader]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within">''[[The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within]]''</ref>}}
These '''ruins''' lay deep within a jungle on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Oznek]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Banks's squadron|squad]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] went on a [[Mission to Oznek|mission]] on the planet, having been led to believe that the planet had allied itself with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During a long trek through the jungle, they came across these ruins, where they were attacked and captured by the native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Toma]].
